result.summary: The food-delivery home screen is mostly polished; the only notable visual problem is the last restaurant card in the Fastest row being clipped mid-word, plus a few small contrast/alignment nits.

issues.description: In the Fastest near you carousel, the third restaurant name is cut off mid-word as “Trattoria Piccol”, making the listing look broken even if the row is meant to scroll.
issues.suggestion: Either reserve enough width so the visible portion of the last card shows a complete name, or fade/ellipsis the title so it doesn’t look truncated mid-word.

issues.description: Search field placeholder text is very light gray on a light gray background, which is hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder (and/or the field fill) to meet WCAG contrast for placeholder text.

issues.description: Promo banner body copy is small white text on a busy green graphic, so “Use code TALLINN3…” is a bit low-contrast and hard to scan.
issues.suggestion: Increase type size/weight or add a slightly darker overlay behind the text so the offer details stay readable.
